name: 1.22.0-beta.16
notes: Find variants is back to how it was in 1.22.0-beta.10. The changes from beta.11 to beta.15 are undone: the “Step by step” method, the AI switch (and its download), and the outline and edge rules.
Everything else stays as it was in beta.10: up to 20 images compared in sections, the image editor, merging layers, and menus keeping their scroll position.
